name: West Trapps parking lot off Route 44/55 (day-use fee, fills early)
basis: Preserve trailhead page: West Trapps Trailhead lot (3700 Route 55) leads to the cliffs, climbing and bouldering, fills very early on peak weekends. MP The Trapps Getting There: pass under the steel bridge, West Trapps parking just downhill on the right; West Trapps Connector leads to the carriage road and the cliff starting at a1 The Uberfall - left. Another source: day-use fee at the lot entrance. Mapped feature is named West Trapps Parking (named.mjs 0.00 km); OSM tags access=customers fee=yes (not private/no). It is the lot for the cliff from the Uberfall onward; the Strictly/Ceiling stretch is assigned separately to the Wawarsing lot.

name: Wawarsing lot on Route 44/55, just past the Visitor Center (day pass)
basis: MP The Trapps Getting There: 'park at the Wawarsing lot, on your right just past the Mohonk Preserve Visitor's Center. Take the East Trapps Connector Trail (the Stairmaster) up; it meets the carriage road at the Strictly / The Ceiling access trail.' Mapped feature named Wawarsing Parking (named.mjs 0.00 km); Preserve page confirms the East Trapps Connector from the Visitor Center area reaches the climbing cliffs.
